_comment: trn2 hardware constants, PER NeuronCore (logical). te_peak_flops bf16. BW in bytes/s. cores_per_node=64 logical (128 physical / 2) — this gates the in-node vs cross-node link threshold, and TP degrees map onto logical cores, so 64 is the right value here. Source: provided 2026-06-02; confirm against Metadata.parquet (Spike S2).
_capacity_comment: HBM PER LOGICAL core (= 2 physical cores). trn2 = 24 GiB/logical core. (trn1 = 16 GiB, trn3 = 144 GiB.)
_hbm_bw_comment: HBM bandwidth PER LOGICAL core, in bytes/s. Source: hbm_ddr_bandwidth from a measured trn2 Metadata.parquet.
_topology_comment: Trainium rack is a torus: TP/CP/PP rings map to mesh axes (bandwidth-optimal), but EP all-to-all is bisection-limited (no full bisection). bisection_bw_bytes_per_s defaults to the cross-node link for torus all-to-all.
